title: nldd lint rule
description: One rule in src/rules/. The file name is the rule id. A rule without assert, report, count or ref forbids its context.

severity.description: error and warn can fail CI. A hint never does: it points at how this is meant to be done.

runtime.description: Only the running page can tell, because the selector reads a :state() a component sets. The linter skips it, and it needs no examples.

tags.description: Components this rule is about, when the selector does not name them.

removed.description: Attributes that are gone from this component, which is what the rule is about. A selector may name them, and being there is enough.

context.description: CSS selector for the elements the rule applies to.

assert.description: Selector the context element must match.

report.description: Selector the context element must not match.

of.description: Selector for the direct children to count.

attr.description: Attribute holding the id of another element.

target.description: Selector the referenced element must match.

equal.description: Attribute that must have the same value on both.

message.description: What is wrong here, in English, for the developer.

aliases.description: Former ids, so baselines and suppressions keep working.
